protocol.selection: best dev NLL, earliest epoch on a tie (strict improvement)
protocol.test_split: never evaluated during training; protected one-time evaluation after the freeze

finiteness_policy.parameters: every parameter, immediately after every optimizer.step() (global post-step hook)
finiteness_policy.module_outputs: every leaf module output in every forward, training and evaluation

derivation.method: accepted trainers on deterministic synthetic names (final_experiment.derive_record_schemas)

note: Frozen at the first run. Any blocking difference stops the pilot until a documented amendment is approved.
